name: Wasp
Desc: The wasp can remove a flower from your deck when used. The wasp cannot remove already placed flowers from the garden.

name: Honey Bee
Desc: The honey bee will turn a single flower golden.

name: Bumble Bee
Desc: The bumblebee can turn a single flower Jumbo.

name: Io Moth
Desc: The Io Moth when used will turn a flower budded.

name: Cabage White
Desc: When used gives the player a random flower tile.

name: Silk Moth
Desc: The Rosy moth when used creates a random item.

name: Comet Moth
Desc: The Comet moth, when used creates a random power-up.

name: Ladybug
Desc: The ladybug when used, doubles current stored money (Maximum 20 coins).

name: Yellow Ladybug
Desc: when used gives you triples current money stored (maximum 30 coins)
